$comment: Config for the ui-parity-mirroring tools. Place at repo root (or scripts/parity/) and run: node <skill>/scripts/parity-gate.mjs

routes.$note: File-router discovery. Next.js: filename 'page.tsx', dir 'app'. For anything else use "list": ["/", "/settings", ...].

i18n.$note: Optional. Omit the whole block to skip i18n checks.

design.$comment: OPTIONAL — omit and check D skips cleanly. When present, the design system is upstream of BOTH clients and the check is symmetric: the source client fails the same way the mirror does. This is what stops a source-client bug becoming the specification.
design.$dirNote: Committed snapshot PULLED FROM the design tool. Read-only in the repo — edit upstream and re-pull, or the next pull reverts your edit. One snapshot, one path: a per-client copy drifts and nothing would catch it.

clients.name: mobile
clients.$note: dart compares names ONLY — values are converted (oklch->sRGB, rem->logical px), so value equality is meaningless
